Supplements.compliance_guardrails: TGA Compliance: No 'cures' or 'treatments'. Focus on 'supports' or 'maintains'. Ensure all health claims are grounded in provided data.

synthesis_rules.title: [Brand] + [Product Type] + [Total Count] + [Dietary Claim]
synthesis_rules.bullets: Use Question-Answer framework. Bullet 1: Immediate Benefit (Is this for my [need]?). Bullet 2: The Proof (Cite specific ingredients).

Supplements.guidelines: If Category = Supplements, prioritize 'Ingredients' and 'Certifications'. Rufus uses ingredients as a primary filter. Focus on Nutrient Density (L3 Ingestion) and Diet Types (Vegan/GF).

Health & Beauty.compliance_guardrails: Texture focus: Rufus looks for 'frizz-control' vs 'volumising' based on hair_type. Ensure OCR-ready text for images (certification logos).

synthesis_rules.title: [Brand] + [Product Type] + [Hair Type/Skin Type] + [Benefit]
synthesis_rules.bullets: Use Question-Answer framework. Bullet 1: Immediate Benefit (Is this for my hair type?). Bullet 2: The Proof (Cite specific ingredients from L2/L3).

Health & Beauty.guidelines: Prioritize Application/Directions and compatibility. Rufus uses ingredients as a primary filter for 'Sensitive Skin' queries.

Electronics.compliance_guardrails: Spec Accuracy: Exactness in wattage and brightness is critical to reduce returns.

synthesis_rules.title: [Brand] + [Product Type] + [Primary Power Source] + [Material]
synthesis_rules.bullets: Use Question-Answer framework. Bullet 1: Compatibility (Will this work with my [device]?). Bullet 2: Technical Proof (Cite specific specs).

Electronics.guidelines: Include key specifications, compatibility, connectivity, battery life, and dimensions. Prioritize technical specifications and material durability.

Pet Supplies.compliance_guardrails: Safety focus: material_type (e.g., Non-toxic rubber) is a primary conversion driver.

synthesis_rules.title: [Brand] + [Product Type] + [Target Species] + [Material/Flavor]
synthesis_rules.bullets: Use Question-Answer framework. Bullet 1: Immediate Benefit (Is this safe for my dog?). Bullet 2: Material/Flavor Proof (Cite specific materials from L2/L3).

Pet Supplies.guidelines: Prioritize Target Species and Flavor/Scent data. Mention target species and durability.

Clothing & Accessories.guidelines: Include material composition, size range, care instructions, and fit type. Lead with style and occasion. Mention seasonal suitability.

Home & Kitchen.guidelines: Include dimensions, material, capacity, power specifications, and care instructions. Lead with the problem it solves.

Sports & Outdoors.guidelines: Include dimensions, weight capacity, material composition, weather resistance, and activity type. Bullet 1 should answer 'Will this fit my [Activity]?' and Bullet 4 should specify exact dimensions for transport.

Baby.guidelines: Include age suitability, safety certifications, material composition, and care instructions. Lead with the developmental benefit. 2026 CDQ mandates Material_Type must not be null.

Toys.guidelines: Include age range, material, dimensions, battery requirements, and safety certifications. Lead with the play/learning benefit.

Grocery.guidelines: Include serving size, nutritional highlights, ingredients, allergen information, storage instructions, and dietary certifications.
